authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the DR-126 platform base/host-ABI TCB and loader-closure design contract: the allowlist taxonomy, the identity/version rule shape, the declared-vs-ambient split, retained loader-trace requirement, and the negative-test classes. It applies nothing, does not populate per-OS package tables, does not re-own DR-G07 extraction, does not re-decide D-006 numbers, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. The DR-126 row remains OPEN until coordinator disposition after independent review.
purpose: Give DR-126 a T2-02 candidate that locks the qualitative TCB shape D-006 left to this row, and reserves populated OS tables as G22 evidence.

tcbTextCarriedVerbatim.surroundingLaw: The full Exact-byte delivery section is L141-166. This row owns the last paragraph (TCB). Extraction/symlink/TOCTOU/spawn-binding remain DR-G07 / DR-103.
linesVerbatim: The signed closure also declares the platform base/host-ABI TCB. A closed
allowlist and identity/version rule covers every permitted OS ABI, loader, libc,
framework, certificate store, font, ICU, and comparable system-class dependency.
Loader traces are retained at qualification. Undeclared library/framework/tool
resolution, alternate loader search, or identity drift refuses; hostile clean
machines prove no ambient system dependency can enter silently.

governingSources.role: INHERITED v1-era pin. Named properties only: D-006 qualitative TCB is this row; numbers are G02; D-002 slice platforms. Live digest is the remeasurement block whose standing is LIVE.

identityRuleShape.declared: Every permitted member appears in the signed closure TCB inventory as exactly the four-field signedEntry { platformProfileKey, class, identityEvidence, originSearchPolicy }. That shape is exhaustive. A three-field form is not a conforming signed entry.

identityEvidence.form: See identityEvidenceUnion. Every signed entry carries exactly one tag from the classMap for its class.

identityRuleShape.sameMeans: Two runtime objects are the same member iff platformProfileKey, class, and identityEvidence compare equal under the class-specific rule. The optional sonameAbi companion inside identityEvidence is excluded from that comparison.
identityRuleShape.drift: Any runtime resolution whose authenticity identityEvidence (PLATFORM-ATTESTED or DIGEST-BOUND, excluding sonameAbi) is not an exact allowlist match. Companion presence/absence/mismatch is metadata only: retained, never allow/refuse.
identityRuleShape.populatedTables: Per-OS concrete members are RESERVED as G22 qualification evidence.

loaderTraces.rule: Loader traces are retained at qualification. Absence of a retained trace is a failed qualification.
observationBoundary: every actual resolution or system-class access attempt by the initial image, late loads, descendants, and helper tools, whether or not the object was declared in the signed TCB
descendants and helper tools the core spawns
non-loader system-class accesses (cert/font/ICU-class) covered by the taxonomy
retainedEventSchema: observedAt (monotonic non-negative integer; unique within the run; strictly increasing from runPreselectionRecord.observedAt through every later event in event order. Two events MUST NOT share observedAt. Non-increasing or duplicate refuses.)
signedCarrierDigest (UTF-8 hex sha-256 of the signed carrier; MUST equal runPreselectionRecord.signedCarrierDigest)
allowlistDigest (UTF-8 hex sha-256 of the signed allowlist table; distinct from signedCarrierDigest)
observedPlatformAttestation (required when identityEvidence tag is PLATFORM-ATTESTED; forbidden otherwise. Closed {authenticityCore, trustDecision}. extrasRejected.)
objectAuthenticityBindRecord (required on PLATFORM-ATTESTED events. Closed OS/scheme-discriminated tag from objectAuthenticityBind.tags. extrasRejected.)

materializedFileIdentity (required exactly when objectAuthenticityBindRecord tag is linux-file-backed AND observedPlatformAttestation.trustDecision.interfaceId is rpm-checksig AND archiveAcquisition used cliInheritedFd. Forbidden on apt-secure, forbidden on the librpm preferredApi branch, forbidden on linux-pathless and macos-codesign. Closed {dir, name, dev, ino, size, sha256, associationToken, selectionKey, archiveDigest}. extrasRejected. {dev,ino,size,sha256} MUST equal cliInheritedFd.identityRecord. associationToken MUST equal openedObjectObservation.associationToken. selectionKey MUST equal archiveAcquisition.selectionKey. archiveDigest MUST equal packagePayloadDigest and authenticityCore.payload.digest.)

descriptorConsumptionRecord (required exactly when objectAuthenticityBindRecord tag is linux-file-backed AND interfaceId is rpm-checksig AND archiveAcquisition used preferredApi. Forbidden on cliInheritedFd, apt-secure, linux-pathless, and macos-codesign. Closed {dev, ino, size, sha256, selectionKey, archiveDigest, associationToken, stages}. extrasRejected. stages is exactly the four strings headerBind, digest, verify, extract in that order. {dev,ino,size,sha256} MUST equal fstat plus sha-256 of the held publisher-archive descriptor. Other equalities as materializedFileIdentity.)
observerProcessIdentity (qualification-run verifier process; not a frozen profile field)
mountNamespaceIdentity (Linux only; later events MUST equal the run-level preselection namespace or refuse)

companionObservation (required when a signed sonameAbi exists at companions.SONAME-ABI.encodingByTag for this event's authenticity tag: PLATFORM-ATTESTED envelope sibling or DIGEST-BOUND payload field; absent only when no companion exists at that one location)
loaderTraces.completenessProof: A trace is complete iff the trusted capture protocol reports sensor-health OK and lifecycle closure, and every actual attempt in the observation boundary is present as an event or an independently checkable inapplicability proof. Self-assertion by an incomplete recorder is not completeness. Partial traces fail. There is no harness-capability escape.

captureProtocol.sensor: A trusted capture source independent of the process under test. The recorder MUST NOT declare its own output complete.
captureProtocol.closureProbes: process-tree enumeration and lifecycle closure markers (start, last-descendant-exit, sensor-health) that can reveal an omitted event
captureProtocol.inapplicabilityProof: An explicit independently checkable proof object naming the class, the reason the class cannot occur on this profile, the probe that would have observed it if it could, and the signed carrier digest. A missing probe is not a proof.

evidenceJoin.table: Every observed event MUST match the signed active-profile table or fail. A false allowlistMatch with used outcome is a failed successor.
evidenceJoin.runBinding: Every later event binds runIdentity, subjectDigest, and signedCarrierDigest to the one runPreselectionRecord. later.signedCarrierDigest MUST equal runPreselectionRecord.signedCarrierDigest. later.observedAt MUST be a retained integer strictly greater than the immediately preceding event observedAt on this run, and unique within the run. later.observerProcessIdentity MUST equal runPreselectionRecord.observerProcessIdentity under observerProcessIdentityShape. On Linux, setnsObservation.verifierBefore and verifierAfter MUST equal that same observerProcessIdentity under the closed {pid,starttime} serialization. There is no preselection eventKind. Any mismatch refuses.
evidenceJoin.INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME: laterEventVariant volume/type equals runPreselectionRecord; Linux also linuxSelectedMountRecordIdentity. If identityEvidence is PLATFORM-ATTESTED, observedPlatformAttestation is required and binds to this event resolvedObjectIdentity.
evidenceJoin.PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED: laterEventVariant.observedPlatformAttestation is the closed {authenticityCore, trustDecision} record. authenticityCore.scheme/payload MUST equal the signed authenticityCore for this class. trustDecision MUST match the scheme variant and result MUST be success. pathlessObservation.subject MUST equal the closed subjectByScheme variant. Volume fields forbidden.
evidenceJoin.EXTERNAL-ORIGIN: laterEventVariant.observedOrigin.actualOrigin is the sensor-emitted origin; lookupStepIndex equals event.route index; actualOrigin binds to resolvedObjectIdentity by same-event association (runIdentity + observedAt), not by projecting a path from object identity. Install-root volume fields forbidden.

companionObservationShape.whenRequired: A signed sonameAbi companion is present at the encodingByTag location: PLATFORM-ATTESTED envelope sibling, or DIGEST-BOUND libc payload field. Observation is then mandatory, not best-effort.
companionObservationShape.whenAbsent: No signed sonameAbi companion is present at that one location. companionObservation is omitted.

closedForms.absent: presence=absent. No soname or abiSelector fields.
closedForms.present: presence=present. soname and abiSelector are required and are the exact observed pair.
closedForms.mismatch: presence=mismatch. soname and abiSelector are required and are the exact observed pair used in the comparison.

companionObservationShape.signedLocation: One location per authenticity tag as companions.SONAME-ABI.encodingByTag. Not both. Not inside PLATFORM-ATTESTED authenticityCore.

observerProcessIdentityShape.linux: Verifier {pid, starttime} as overall field 22. Distinct from setnsObservation.helperProcessIdentity. Both are retained.
observerProcessIdentityShape.macos: {pid, kp_proc.p_starttime}. Before-and-after equality required around statfs.

mountNamespaceIdentityShape.linux: inode of the held ns/mnt descriptor. setnsObservation.receivedNsfdInode and helperPostSetnsNsInode MUST equal it.

laterEventVolumeFields.standing: RETIRED. No producer of any generation may emit this schema. EXTERNAL-ORIGIN is origin-only. Volume fields exist only on the INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME laterEventVariant.

loaderTraces.volumeEquality: Delegated to evidenceJoin per tag. INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME only. PATHLESS and EXTERNAL MUST NOT use install-root volume equality.

runPreselectionRecord.standing: Closed qualification-run record. Not an eventKind.
forbidden: volumeConstraint tag fields of later events
runPreselectionRecord.afterSelection: Later events bind runIdentity, subjectDigest, and signedCarrierDigest to this record. completePlatformProfileKey appears only on post-selection events.
runPreselectionRecord.supersedes: v13 eventKind preselection, v14/v15 preselectionRecord alias (deleted), and laterEventVolumeFields. Producers emit runPreselectionRecord only.

fields.val0: int32 first f_fsid component as canonical decimal: optional leading U+002D for negative, then 1-10 digits with no leading zeros except the number 0 itself
fields.val1: int32 second f_fsid component, same canonical decimal

macosVolumeIdentity.componentOrder: val0 then val1. No other order.
macosVolumeIdentity.oneSpelling: +0, 00, and 0 are not three spellings; only 0 is lawful for zero. No plus sign.
macosVolumeIdentity.equality: val0 numeric equal AND val1 numeric equal AND each field uses the canonical decimal spelling

fields.decodedMountPoint: UTF-8 bytes after kernel octal-escape decode; if the decoded bytes are not valid UTF-8, refuse
fields.major: non-negative integer parsed from mountinfo device major
fields.minor: non-negative integer parsed from mountinfo device minor

linuxVolumeIdentity.deviceParse: split mountinfo device on U+003A into exactly two decimal integers; any other form refuses
linuxVolumeIdentity.equality: decodedMountPoint UTF-8 bytes equal AND major numeric equal AND minor numeric equal

observedAttestation.producersEmit: Never as a complete event record. This object is only the nested authenticityCore serialization inside observedPlatformAttestation.
observedAttestation.retiredGenericDescriptions: The prior generic 40-hex SHA-1 / 64-hex SHA-256 field descriptions on this path are retired. The canonical payload encodings live on authenticityCore.
observedAttestation.equality: scheme tag equal AND payload fields byte-equal as defined on authenticityCore
observedAttestation.note: Legacy alias of authenticityCore only. Producers MUST emit observedPlatformAttestation as the complete PLATFORM-ATTESTED observation. A bare observedAttestation event field is not a lawful complete record.

fields.lookupStepIndex: MUST equal resolverObservation.lookupStepIndex and event.route index

observedOrigin.binding: actualOrigin bytes are the canonical path captured by resolverObservation for this same later event (runIdentity + observedAt). resolvedObjectIdentity is associated by that same-event token, not by projecting a path from the object identity.
observedOrigin.equality: actualOrigin UTF-8 bytes equal signed canonicalOrigin AND lookupStepIndex numeric equal

setnsObservation.when: Linux only. Required on runPreselectionRecord. Forbidden on macOS.
setnsObservation.helperProcessIdentity: {pid, starttime} of the dedicated helper; starttime is overall field 22
setnsObservation.receivedNsfdInode: decimal inode of the ns fd the helper received
setnsObservation.helperPostSetnsNsInode: inode of /proc/self/ns/mnt after setns; MUST equal receivedNsfdInode and heldNsInodeBefore/After
setnsObservation.mountinfoBytes: the exact /proc/self/mountinfo byte sequence read after successful setns. This is the retained evidence object.
setnsObservation.mountinfoDigest: 64-hex lowercase sha-256 of mountinfoBytes. MUST equal sha-256(mountinfoBytes).
setnsObservation.verifierBefore: {pid, starttime} of the verifier recorded immediately before helper start. MUST equal runPreselectionRecord.observerProcessIdentity under observerProcessIdentityShape.linux closed {pid, starttime} serialization.
setnsObservation.verifierAfter: {pid, starttime} of the verifier recorded immediately after helper exit. MUST equal verifierBefore AND runPreselectionRecord.observerProcessIdentity under that same serialization.
setnsObservation.heldNsInodeBefore: fstat of the held ns fd immediately before helper start
setnsObservation.heldNsInodeAfter: fstat of the held ns fd immediately after helper exit; MUST equal heldNsInodeBefore and receivedNsfdInode
setnsObservation.derivation: linuxSelectedMountRecordIdentity and filesystemTypeToken MUST be derived from mountinfoBytes by filesystemMeasurementTarget.linux.recordSelection and .token. A selection that cannot be replayed from mountinfoBytes refuses.
setnsObservation.ordering: verifierBefore and heldNsInodeBefore, then helper setns, then mountinfoBytes, then helper exit, then verifierAfter and heldNsInodeAfter.
setnsObservation.failClosed: Mismatch, missing field, extra field, helper death, or verifier/run-identity inequality refuses the profile.
setnsObservation.runJoin: verifierBefore = verifierAfter = runPreselectionRecord.observerProcessIdentity. Later events observerProcessIdentity MUST use that same value. Any mismatch refuses.

resolverObservation.when: EXTERNAL-ORIGIN later events. Required. Forbidden on PATHLESS.
resolverObservation.capturedPath: the exact path or object-handle-derived path emitted by the trusted resolver sensor for this same resolution operation that produced resolvedObjectIdentity. Association token is the same-resolution capture, not a projection from resolvedObjectIdentity.
resolverObservation.canonicalPath: filesystemMeasurementTarget.canonicalization of capturedPath (resolve every symlink; refuse if not exactly one path), then NFC then UTF-8
resolverObservation.lookupStepIndex: MUST equal event.route index in signed allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder
resolverObservation.binding: canonicalPath UTF-8 bytes MUST equal observedOrigin.actualOrigin AND signed canonicalOrigin. resolvedObjectIdentity is the authenticity identity of the object opened by this same later event (same runIdentity + observedAt). There is no path projection from object identity. Binding is same-event association, not identity-to-path derivation.
resolverObservation.failure: If capturedPath is absent, handle-to-path derivation fails, or canonicalization is not exactly one path, refuse.
resolverObservation.associationToken: The containing later-event identity (runIdentity + observedAt) is the association token. observedAt is unique and strictly increasing within the run, so the token is unique. capturedPath, canonicalPath, and resolvedObjectIdentity belong to that token only. Cross-event composition is forbidden.

observedAtRule.domain: Every runPreselectionRecord.observedAt and every later event observedAt on that runIdentity
observedAtRule.order: strictly increasing in event order. preselection is first. each later event MUST be greater than the immediately preceding event observedAt.
observedAtRule.associationToken: runIdentity + observedAt. Because observedAt is unique, the token is unique. capturedPath, canonicalPath, and resolvedObjectIdentity bind to this token only.
observedAtRule.refuse: missing, duplicate, non-integer, negative, or non-increasing observedAt refuses the run

observedPlatformAttestation.whenRequired: identityEvidence tag is PLATFORM-ATTESTED, pathless or file-backed
observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore: exactly PLATFORM-ATTESTED.authenticityCore {scheme, payload}. Not a second schema. Signed-to-observed identity equality uses this member only.

package-db.interfaceId: exactly one of rpm-checksig | apt-secure as selected by publisherToInterface
package-db.publisher: the profile publisher knownId that selected the interface

observedPlatformAttestation.sameSubjectBinding: Both members are produced from the same platformAttestationOperation execution against the same pathless subject or the same resolvedObjectIdentity. Mixing members from two executions refuses.

objectAuthenticityBind.standing: Closed OS/scheme-discriminated retained record. Required for every PLATFORM-ATTESTED observation. Package ownership metadata alone MUST NOT establish object authenticity.
objectAuthenticityBind.form: exactly one tag from the closed enum below. extrasRejected.

macos-codesign.when: osFamily macos and scheme codesign, pathless or file-backed

sameGuestBind.form: {associationToken, inputKind, checkValidityStatus, signingInfoStatus, cdhash}. extrasRejected. Not a native SecCodeRef.
sameGuestBind.cdhash: 40-hex lowercase from kSecCodeInfoUnique of that same guest
sameGuestBind.tie: these fields are the outputs of one macosCodesign.orderedStepsSameGuest execution for this event

linux-file-backed.when: osFamily linux and scheme package-db and volume tag INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME or EXTERNAL-ORIGIN

openedObjectObservation.canonicalPath: NFC-then-UTF-8 path of the same-event opened object
openedObjectObservation.openedBytesSha256: 64-hex lowercase sha-256 of the exact bytes read from the same opened handle
openedObjectObservation.associationToken: runIdentity + observedAt of this later event. This is the only associationToken placement on this tag.

packageRelativePathRule.soleGrammar: archiveMemberPathGrammar is the only normative path grammar. Both INSTALL and EXTERNAL transforms MUST emit a string in that grammar before equality.
packageRelativePathRule.INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME: strip the unique hostLocalCanonicalPath prefix, then apply archiveMemberPathGrammar. Remainder MUST equal matchedManifestMember.relativePath.
packageRelativePathRule.EXTERNAL-ORIGIN: canonicalOrigin is a file path. Its directory is every component except the last. The opened object MUST equal canonicalOrigin or be under that directory; otherwise refuse. If equal, relativePath is the last component after archiveMemberPathGrammar. If under the directory, strip that directory prefix then apply archiveMemberPathGrammar. No fallback to the full path outside that directory.

linux-file-backed.matchedManifestMember: {relativePath, sha256}. extrasRejected. Subject to joinMust. Duplicate relativePath refuses. Duplicate sha256 is lawful.
linux-file-backed.packagePayloadDigest: 64-hex sha-256 of the exact archive bytes used for signature verification and extraction. MUST equal authenticityCore.payload.digest.
linux-file-backed.joinMust: matchedManifestMember.relativePath MUST equal the package-relative path produced by archiveMemberPathGrammar after the volume-tag transform. matchedManifestMember.sha256 MUST equal openedObjectObservation.openedBytesSha256. Those two fields MUST identify the same single authenticatedManifest member. Zero matches, more than one path match, or a hash-only match to a different member refuses. Hash uniqueness of the whole manifest is not required once path+hash selects the member.
linux-file-backed.rpmHeaderIdentity: present only when observedPlatformAttestation.trustDecision.interfaceId is rpm-checksig. Forbidden on apt-secure. Closed {sha256header, nevra, associationToken}. extrasRejected. sha256header MUST equal the normalized 64-hex output of headerIdentity.queryArgv for that same nevra. nevra MUST equal archiveAcquisition.selectionKey. associationToken MUST equal openedObjectObservation.associationToken. MUST NOT be used as, derived as, or substituted for packagePayloadDigest or authenticityCore.payload.digest.
linux-file-backed.materializedFileIdentity: required exactly when observedPlatformAttestation.trustDecision.interfaceId is rpm-checksig AND archiveAcquisition used cliInheritedFd. Forbidden when preferredApi, apt-secure, linux-pathless, or macos-codesign. Closed {dir, name, dev, ino, size, sha256, associationToken, selectionKey, archiveDigest}. extrasRejected. {dev,ino,size,sha256} MUST equal cliInheritedFd.identityRecord. associationToken MUST equal openedObjectObservation.associationToken. selectionKey MUST equal archiveAcquisition.selectionKey. archiveDigest MUST equal packagePayloadDigest and authenticityCore.payload.digest.
linux-file-backed.descriptorConsumptionRecord: required exactly when interfaceId is rpm-checksig AND archiveAcquisition used preferredApi. Forbidden when cliInheritedFd, apt-secure, linux-pathless, or macos-codesign. Closed {dev, ino, size, sha256, selectionKey, archiveDigest, associationToken, stages}. extrasRejected. stages MUST be exactly [headerBind, digest, verify, extract]. {dev,ino,size,sha256} MUST equal fstat plus sha-256 of the held publisher-archive descriptor. Other equalities as materializedFileIdentity.

linux-pathless.when: osFamily linux and scheme package-db and volume tag PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED

measuredBootBind.eventLog: TCG2 GetEventLog / EFI_TCG2_PROTOCOL.GetEventLog bytes for this boot. Retained exactly.

kernelEvent.digestSha256: 64-hex lowercase PE/COFF Authenticode image digest from the event. MUST NOT be treated as a flat file sha-256.
kernelEvent.eventData: UEFI_IMAGE_LOAD_EVENT bytes from the log at this event
kernelEvent.logIndex: non-negative integer index of this event in eventLog order

pcrSelection.pcrSelect: exactly PCR bits 4 and 7 set; all other bits 0

quote.verifierChallenge: 32-byte CSPRNG value generated by the verifier at quote time. Not derived from runIdentity, observedAt, subject, or signedCarrierDigest.
quote.nonce: 32-byte sha-256 of pathlessCeremony.nonceBind over this event associationToken
quote.pcrDigest: 32-byte digest over the selected PCR SHA-256 banks in the quote

measuredBootBind.akCertificateMember: the unique certificate-store DIGEST-BOUND signed TCB member that verifies the AK signature. Closed {platformProfileKey, class, identityEvidence}. extrasRejected. Unknown AK refuses.
measuredBootBind.secureBootEvents: the PCR-7 EV_EFI_VARIABLE_DRIVER_CONFIG events for SecureBoot, PK, KEK, db, and dbx from the same eventLog. Retained exactly.
measuredBootBind.equality: kernelEvent.digestSha256 MUST equal authenticatedKernelMember.peCoffImageDigest. MUST NOT equal, be compared to, or be substituted for authenticatedKernelMember.sha256.

linux-pathless.authenticatedKernelMember: {relativePath, sha256, peCoffImageDigest}. extrasRejected. Unique regular-file authenticatedManifest member at relativePath. sha256 is the 64-hex flat sha-256 of those exact member bytes and MUST equal that manifest member sha256. peCoffImageDigest is the 64-hex PE/COFF Authenticode image digest of those same exact bytes computed by pathlessCeremony.peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm. peCoffImageDigest MUST equal kernelEvent.digestSha256. Zero path matches, more than one path match, or a member that is not a PE/COFF image refuses. relativePath uniqueness required; sha256 uniqueness of the whole manifest is not required.
linux-pathless.packagePayloadDigest: 64-hex sha-256 of the exact archive bytes used for signature verification and extraction. MUST equal authenticityCore.payload.digest.
linux-pathless.measuredBootProcedureRef: identityEvidenceUnion.tags.PLATFORM-ATTESTED.platformAttestationOperation.linuxPackageDb.pathlessCeremony is the only normative procedure. IMA file measurement and NT_GNU_BUILD_ID are not this bind.

authenticatedManifest.form: closed list of {relativePath, sha256}. extrasRejected on each member.
authenticatedManifest.builtFrom: the same archive bytes whose digest is packagePayloadDigest, after signature/index verification of those exact bytes
authenticatedManifest.uniqueness: relativePath MUST be unique after archiveMemberPathGrammar. Duplicate sha256 is lawful. joinMust selects on path and hash together. This supersedes any earlier sha256-uniqueness refusal.

archiveMemberPathGrammar.longestPrefixStrip: strip at most one leading './' only. Do not strip a lawful leading '.' that is part of a filename. Do not strip multiple prefixes.
archiveMemberPathGrammar.unicode: NFC then UTF-8 after prefix strip
archiveMemberPathGrammar.rpmCpio: apply longestPrefixStrip to the cpio member name, then reject
archiveMemberPathGrammar.debDataTar: apply longestPrefixStrip to the data.tar member name, then reject. APT authenticatedManifest MUST be built with this rule only.
archiveMemberPathGrammar.componentWise: split on U+002F and reject any component that is empty, ".", or ".."
archiveMemberPathGrammar.links: symlink/hardlink members are not digest members. A digest member MUST be a regular file.
archiveMemberPathGrammar.soleInput: authenticatedManifest.relativePath and packageRelativePathRule both MUST use this grammar only.

negativeTests.name: undeclared resolution
negativeTests.passProperty: An undeclared object on the active complete profile refuses. Required for every profile × every taxonomy class, or an explicit proof that the class is absent/inapplicable. Inability to observe or substitute is a qualification failure or platform-removal path, not a skipped cell.

negativeTests.name: alternate loader search
negativeTests.passProperty: A declared-name object found only outside originSearchPolicy.allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder refuses.

negativeTests.name: identity drift
negativeTests.passProperty: A declared-name object whose tagged identityEvidence does not match refuses.

negativeTests.name: hostile clean machine
negativeTests.passProperty: On a clean machine with ambient substitutes present, no undeclared system dependency enters.

g22.testMatrix: every complete platformProfile × every taxonomy class × NT-TCB-1..4, or explicit absent/inapplicable proof. No "that the harness can substitute" quantifier.

whatThisDoesNotDo: Does not SATISFY DR-126 until independently reviewed and recorded by a later D-000 MF-6.
Does not populate per-OS allowlist rows.
Does not re-own archive extraction / symlink / TOCTOU (DR-G07).
Does not re-decide D-006 size numbers.
Does not put language-runtime/Node into the core TCB (those are DR-119 component closures).
Does not remove linux/x86_64 or linux/arm64 from D-002 slice-1 platforms. A machine that cannot produce measuredBootBind fails qualification; the platform class remains.
Does not treat a PE/COFF Authenticode image digest as interchangeable with a flat file sha-256.
Does not treat rpmdb as a publisher archive and does not download a missing .rpm.

linux.observerProcess: The verifier process that performs preselection observation. observerProcessIdentity is {pid, starttime} where starttime is overall field 22 (twentieth token after comm's final ')', post-delimiter index 19). Open /proc/<pid>/stat and /proc/<pid>/ns/mnt; record {pid,starttime} and fstat the ns fd. The only lawful Linux mountinfo reader is a dedicated helper that (1) receives the held ns fd, (2) enters that namespace with setns(nsfd, CLONE_NEWNS), (3) reads /proc/self/mountinfo, (4) exits. /proc/<verifierPid>/mountinfo opened from the observer's namespace is not the interface. Retain helper {pid,starttime}, the nsfd inode, and evidence that the bytes were read after successful setns. setns failure, helper death, or nsfd stale refuses. Re-read {pid,starttime} and fstat the held ns fd after the helper returns. Any pair or inode change refuses.
linux.namespace: Linux mount-namespace identity is the inode of the held /proc/<pid>/ns/mnt descriptor. The only lawful Linux mountinfo reader is a dedicated helper that (1) receives the held ns fd, (2) enters that namespace with setns(nsfd, CLONE_NEWNS), (3) reads /proc/self/mountinfo, (4) exits. /proc/<verifierPid>/mountinfo opened from the observer's namespace is not the interface. Select the active complete (not stem-only) qualified platformProfile whose filesystem member matches that target.

If EXTERNAL-ORIGIN: join canonicalOrigin / allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder via resolverObservation same-resolution association; do not require install-root volume equality.
Allow only an exact allowlist match under identityEvidenceUnion AND originSearchPolicy.
Every other source or route is ambient/alternate and MUST refuse.

authenticityCore.excludes: sonameAbi is never a member of authenticityCore and never participates in signed-to-observed authenticity equality.
authenticityCore.trustDecisionRequired: Observed authenticityCore is incomplete without a retained successful trustDecision from platformAttestationOperation. A cdhash or {name,version,digest} returned without result=success is not success. Invalid, untrusted, unavailable, ambiguous, or mismatched refuses.

packageBytes.collection: the unique byte sequence the package-db verification operation attests as that package's canonical payload under the database's published membership/root rule for {name, version}. If that rule does not yield exactly one byte sequence, refuse.
packageBytes.digestInput: exactly those payload bytes. No other files, signatures, or metadata unless the published membership/root rule includes them.

signedForm.form: exactly {authenticityCore, optional sonameAbi}. extrasRejected on the envelope.
signedForm.sonameAbi: optional signed-only sibling metadata on libc entries; forbidden on non-libc; never inside authenticityCore.payload; never part of authenticity equality

observedForm.loaderTracesAlias: loaderTraces.identitySerializations.observedAttestation is this same object, not a second definition.

PLATFORM-ATTESTED.sameSerialization: signed authenticityCore MUST equal observed authenticityCore field-for-field under the encodings above. sonameAbi is excluded from that equality. companionObservation is the only observed companion record. There is no second observed path.

codesign.observation: platformAttestationOperation.macosCodesign against the running kernel / OS ABI code object, same guest for validity and kSecCodeInfoUnique.
codesign.successResult: orderedStepsSameGuest all succeed and produce exactly one cdhash. A returned cdhash without trustDecision.result=success refuses.
codesign.canonicalSerialization: JSON object with keys in order kind, cdhash; cdhash is 40 lowercase hex; extras rejected.
codesign.binding: pathlessObservation.subject MUST equal this object. observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore.scheme MUST be codesign. observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore.payload.cdhash MUST equal subject.cdhash. signed pathlessObservation.subject MUST equal the observed subject. Mismatch refuses.

package-db.name: NFC UTF-8
package-db.digest: 64-hex lowercase sha-256 of the running-kernel package bytes
package-db.observation: Linux pathless uses objectAuthenticityBind.tags.linux-pathless measuredBootBind (TCG2 event log + TPM2_Quote SHA-256 bank over PCR 4 and PCR 7 + PE/COFF image-digest equality). IMA file measurement and executingKernelBuildId are not this observation. Filename/osrelease is not this observation.
package-db.successResult: mapped interface reports success and produces exactly one {name, version, digest} whose digest equals the named packageBytes digest. Unmapped publisher refuses.
package-db.canonicalSerialization: JSON object with keys in order kind, name, version, digest; extras rejected.
package-db.binding: pathlessObservation.subject MUST equal this object. observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore.scheme MUST be package-db. measuredBootBind.kernelEvent.digestSha256 MUST equal authenticatedKernelMember.peCoffImageDigest. authenticityCore.payload.digest is the archive digest (flat sha-256 of publisher archive bytes) and MUST equal packagePayloadDigest. signed pathlessObservation.subject MUST equal the observed subject. Mismatch or unavailable TPM/log/UEFI-Secure-Boot/PE-image refuses this machine, not the Linux slice-1 class.

optionalLibcCompanion.location: signed-only sibling on the libc envelope, outside authenticityCore. Never inside payload.
optionalLibcCompanion.comparison: sonameAbi is metadata only. Presence, absence, or mismatch NEVER changes allow/refuse and is not authenticity drift. Retained as companionObservation. Observed companion is never nested under taggedEvidenceForm or authenticityCore.

platformAttestationOperation.standing: Closed. Required for every PLATFORM-ATTESTED observation, pathless and file-backed.

macosCodesign.guest: SecCodeCopyGuestWithAttributes on the input code object. Pathless input is the running kernel / OS ABI code object. File-backed input is the resolved object of this later event.
orderedStepsSameGuest: SecCodeCheckValidity(guest, kSecCSDefaultFlags, NULL) MUST return errSecSuccess (0)
cdhash is the 20-byte CFData at kSecCodeInfoUnique in that info dictionary, encoded as 40-hex lowercase. If kSecCodeInfoUnique is absent or not exactly 20 bytes, refuse.
macosCodesign.sameGuestRule: Steps 2-4 MUST use the guest from step 1. A validity result and a cdhash from different guests refuse.
macosCodesign.trustDecision: {scheme: codesign, interfaceId: SecCodeCheckValidity, signingInfoInterfaceId: SecCodeCopySigningInformation, status: 0, result: success}
macosCodesign.identifierBinding: observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore.payload.cdhash MUST equal that kSecCodeInfoUnique encoding from the same guest.
macosCodesign.fileBackedInput: the same-event resolved object, obtained as the SecCode guest in step 1. Not a separately opened path.
macosCodesign.pathlessInput: the running kernel / OS ABI code object as the SecCode guest in step 1. Not a kernelcache pathname substitute.
macosCodesign.sameGuestBindRecord: objectAuthenticityBind.tags.macos-codesign.sameGuestBind is the only retained same-guest evidence. Do not retain a SecCodeRef.

publisherToInterface.note: alpine and arch remain lawful profile-selector knownIds. They have no PLATFORM-ATTESTED package-db interface in this contract. A PLATFORM-ATTESTED Linux entry whose publisher is alpine, arch, or OTHER-PUBLISHER refuses until a later successor names that interface.

linuxPackageDb.runningKernelImagePath: RETIRED as an authenticity bind. Use measuredBootBind. Filename/osrelease and executingKernelBuildId MUST NOT establish authenticity.

rpm-checksig.success: exit 0 and stdout is exactly one NEVRA line after trimming a single trailing newline. Any other exit, zero lines, or more than one NEVRA refuses.

apt-secure.success: exit 0 and exactly one package name before the colon. Ambiguous or none refuses.

owningPackageLookup.pathlessPath: Not an authenticity input. Package NEVRA for pathless Linux is the signed OS ABI allowlist member, not a /boot ownership query.
owningPackageLookup.fileBackedPath: Not an authenticity input. If used at all, it only nominates a package NEVRA/name to acquire. Authenticity is objectAuthenticityBindRecord only.

rpm-checksig.versionedInterface: rpm(8) --checksig as shipped by the publisher userspace. This contract does not pin an rpm major; a missing rpm binary refuses.
rpm-checksig.packageBytes: the publisher archive file bytes at archiveAcquisition.publisherArchivePath, consumed via the held descriptor. authenticityCore.payload.digest is sha-256 of those exact bytes. rpmdb does not contain those bytes and MUST NOT be treated as the archive.
rpm-checksig.nameVersion: authenticityCore.payload.name and .version are the NEVRA name and EVR parsed from the publisher archive header. digest is sha-256 of those archive bytes.

archiveAcquisition.selectionKey: the unique NEVRA in rpmdb. Zero or more than one refuses. That NEVRA MUST equal authenticityCore.payload.name plus EVR.
archiveAcquisition.publisherArchivePath: qualification-run input. NFC UTF-8 absolute path of an already-present regular file that is the publisher .rpm for selectionKey. This contract does not download, reconstruct from rpmdb, or invent archive bytes. Absence, non-regular-file, or open failure refuses this machine.

preferredApi.name: librpm
preferredApi.open: openat(AT_FDCWD, publisherArchivePath, O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC) then fdopen. That one descriptor is the archive. rpmReadPackageFile is applied to that descriptor, never to an rpmdb iterator and never to an undefined blob.
preferredApi.headerBind: read lead, signature header, and immutable header from the held descriptor. Parse NEVRA from that header. That NEVRA MUST equal selectionKey MUST equal authenticityCore.payload.name plus EVR. Compute SHA256HEADER over the immutable header region using the same preimage rpm uses for %{SHA256HEADER}. That value MUST equal headerIdentity.queryArgv for selectionKey.
preferredApi.hold: keep that descriptor open across headerBind, digest, verify, and extract. lseek to 0 between stages. Do not close and reopen.
preferredApi.digest: sha-256 of pread of the entire descriptor from offset 0 to EOF. MUST equal authenticityCore.payload.digest.

verify.on: rpmts created for this run; header and fd from rpmReadPackageFile on the same descriptor after lseek 0
verify.success: return value RPMRC_OK (0) and no failed signature class. Any other return, missing signature, or untrusted key refuses.

extract.on: the same descriptor after verify and lseek 0
extract.bytes: for each regular-file member, hash the exact payload bytes returned by rpmfiArchiveRead. relativePath via archiveMemberPathGrammar.rpmCpio. authenticatedManifest is the closed list of {relativePath, sha256} from those extracted bytes. authenticatedManifest.builtFrom is those extracted regular-file payload bytes from this descriptor. Directory, symlink, and device members are not sha256 members.

preferredApi.descriptorIdentity: {dev, ino, size, sha256} from fstat plus the digest stage of the held descriptor. Retained as descriptorConsumptionRecord.
preferredApi.retained: descriptorConsumptionRecord. Forbidden to also emit materializedFileIdentity on this branch.

cliInheritedFd.when: only if librpm preferredApi is unavailable (missing librpm). Same publisherArchivePath.
cliInheritedFd.sourceOpen: openat(AT_FDCWD, publisherArchivePath, O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC). headerBind and digest as preferredApi on this source fd.
cliInheritedFd.dir: mkdirat a run-owned directory mode 0700 owned by observerProcessIdentity
cliInheritedFd.name: NEVRA encoded as [A-Za-z0-9._+-]+ only; any other character refuses
cliInheritedFd.copy: openat(dirfd, name, O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_RDWR|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC, 0600). copy every byte from the source fd onto this copy fd (splice or read/write). fsync the copy. Do not write an rpmdb blob. The only source is publisherArchivePath.
cliInheritedFd.identityRecord: {dev, ino, size, sha256} from fstat and sha-256 of the copy fd. sha256 MUST equal the source digest and authenticityCore.payload.digest.
cliInheritedFd.handoff: dup2 the held copy fd onto a designated inherited fd N (N>=3). fcntl N to clear FD_CLOEXEC. Child argv pathname is exactly /dev/fd/N. Immediately before execve, fstat(copy fd) MUST equal identityRecord. The child inherits fd N so /dev/fd/N is that same file description. MUST NOT pass publisherArchivePath or any other pathname to the child. Post-exit fstat of the parent-held copy fd MUST still equal identityRecord; that check is additional and is not the identity proof.
cliInheritedFd.checksigSuccess: exit 0 AND stdout contains the exact token "digests signatures OK".
cliInheritedFd.extractBytes: parent consumes the child stdout cpio stream and hashes each regular-file payload member. authenticatedManifest is built from those extracted bytes. authenticatedManifest.builtFrom is that stream. relativePath via archiveMemberPathGrammar.rpmCpio.
cliInheritedFd.retained: materializedFileIdentity {dir, name, dev, ino, size, sha256, associationToken, selectionKey, archiveDigest}. extrasRejected. Forbidden to also emit descriptorConsumptionRecord on this branch.

headerIdentity.role: optional retained rpm header identity. MUST NOT be used as, derived as, or substituted for authenticityCore.payload.digest. When rpmHeaderIdentity is present it MUST equal this query output for the same NEVRA.
headerIdentity.outputGrammar: exactly 64 lowercase hex characters or refuse
headerIdentity.retainedField: rpmHeaderIdentity on linux-file-backed events when present. Closed {sha256header, nevra, associationToken}. extrasRejected. sha256header MUST equal the normalized 64-hex output of headerIdentity.queryArgv for that same nevra. nevra MUST equal archiveAcquisition.selectionKey. associationToken MUST equal openedObjectObservation.associationToken.

apt-secure.versionedInterface: dpkg-query(1) plus the currently trusted apt Release/Packages index verified by apt-secure (apt-get 1.x/2.x gpgv path). A missing dpkg-query or missing trusted index refuses.
apt-secure.installedSuccess: exit 0, Status contains the exact token "install ok installed", and Version is exactly one non-empty string.
apt-secure.indexSha256: the unique SHA256 field for that name/version in the currently trusted apt Packages index. If the trusted index does not contain exactly one SHA256 for that name/version, refuse.
apt-secure.packageBytes: the unique .deb payload the trusted index associates with that SHA256. authenticityCore.payload.digest MUST equal that 64-hex lowercase SHA256.
apt-secure.nameVersion: authenticityCore.payload.name is the dpkg name; .version is the dpkg Version; digest is the index SHA256.

archiveAcquisition.trustedIndex: the unique currently trusted apt Packages record for this name/version after apt-secure Release verification. Zero or more than one record refuses.
archiveAcquisition.filenameField: the Filename field of that record
archiveAcquisition.acquire: exactly one .deb whose pool path is that Filename
archiveAcquisition.preExtractDigest: sha-256 of those exact .deb bytes MUST equal the Packages SHA256 field AND authenticityCore.payload.digest
archiveAcquisition.extractAfter: only after digest match, extract authenticatedManifest from that .deb data.tar using archiveMemberPathGrammar.debDataTar only.

linuxPackageDb.trustDecision: {scheme: package-db, interfaceId: rpm-checksig|apt-secure, result: success, publisher: knownId}
linuxPackageDb.failClosed: Unmapped publisher, OTHER-PUBLISHER, missing binary, missing publisherArchivePath, non-unique owning package, failed signature, missing digest, header NEVRA mismatch, or identifier/trust mismatch refuses before profile qualification.
linuxPackageDb.objectByteJoin: linux-file-backed requires joinMust. linux-pathless requires measuredBootBind.kernelEvent.digestSha256 equality to authenticatedKernelMember.peCoffImageDigest. IMA/build-id/filename are not executing-kernel binds. Linux remains a D-002 slice-1 platform.

pathlessCeremony.inScopeBootConfigs: UEFI class firmware with TPM 2.0 and TCG2 event log; Secure Boot enabled; the executing kernel is a PE/COFF EFI-stub image that this firmware LoadImage and StartImage as a boot services application so that PCR 4 contains a pre-EV_SEPARATOR EV_EFI_BOOT_SERVICES_APPLICATION whose Authenticode digest is that kernel image.
pathlessCeremony.refusesBootConfigs: BIOS/legacy; GRUB/systemd-boot or any bootloader path in which firmware LoadImage/StartImage is the loader rather than the kernel; no TPM 2.0; no TCG2 log; Secure Boot disabled; non-PE/COFF kernel; SHA-1-only PCR bank; zero or more than one matching pre-separator kernel event. Those machines fail qualification. Linux remains in platforms.slice1. No D-096 (A).

peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm.name: PE/COFF Authenticode image digest
peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm.specification: Windows Authenticode Portable Executable Signature Format image hash. This is the digest UEFI LoadImage extends into PCR 4 for EV_EFI_BOOT_SERVICES_APPLICATION.
exclude: IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER.CheckSum (4 bytes at its PE-specified offset)
the attribute certificate table region those 8 bytes name (WIN_CERTIFICATE blob), if present
order: Hash from file offset 0 through the byte immediately before CheckSum
Skip CheckSum (4 bytes; do not hash)
Hash from the byte after CheckSum through the byte immediately before IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY
Skip the 8-byte Security directory entry (do not hash)
Hash from the byte after that entry through the last byte before the attribute certificate table, or through EOF if no certificate table
Do not hash the attribute certificate table
If bytes exist after the certificate table, hash them in file order
peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm.notThis: flat sha-256 of the file bytes. authenticatedKernelMember.sha256 remains that flat digest and MUST NOT be compared to kernelEvent.digestSha256.

kernelEventSelection.collect: every TCG_PCR_EVENT2 in eventLog order whose pcrIndex is 4, eventType is EV_EFI_BOOT_SERVICES_APPLICATION, and that appears before the first PCR-4 EV_SEPARATOR
kernelEventSelection.match: among that set, the unique event whose SHA-256 digest equals some authenticatedManifest regular-file member peCoffImageDigest computed from that member exact bytes
kernelEventSelection.result: that event is kernelEvent. Zero matches or more than one match refuses.
kernelEventSelection.notCircular: selection is digest-match to a payload member image digest, not the phrase whose digest is the loaded kernel image.

enforcedBootPolicy.measuringAgent: UEFI firmware LoadImage. kernelEvent MUST be produced by that firmware before the first PCR-4 EV_SEPARATOR.
enforcedBootPolicy.controlTransfer: firmware StartImage of the same EFI_HANDLE whose LoadImage produced kernelEvent. A firmware that measures an image it does not StartImage refuses.
enforcedBootPolicy.secureBoot: eventLog PCR-7 MUST contain EV_EFI_VARIABLE_DRIVER_CONFIG for SecureBoot with value 1, plus PK, KEK, db, and dbx. Quoted PCR 7 SHA-256 MUST equal pathlessCeremony.replayAlgorithm reconstruction of PCR 7.
enforcedBootPolicy.imageSignature: authenticatedKernelMember PE Authenticode signature MUST verify against the measured db. A dbx match refuses.
enforcedBootPolicy.excludesSyntheticExtend: An OS-time or post-separator PCR-4 extend of an approved digest cannot be kernelEvent. A bootloader that extends an approved digest and then transfers control to different kernel bytes has no pre-separator firmware LoadImage of those kernel bytes and refuses.

replayAlgorithm.hashAlg: TPM_ALG_SHA256 only. Other banks are not used and MUST NOT be selected.
replayAlgorithm.step: for each TCG_PCR_EVENT2 in eventLog order whose pcrIndex equals the reconstructed PCR: new = SHA-256(old || event.digests[TPM_ALG_SHA256])
replayAlgorithm.pcr4: reconstruct pcrIndex 4; MUST equal the quoted PCR 4 SHA-256 value; MUST include kernelEvent at kernelEvent.logIndex
replayAlgorithm.pcr7: reconstruct pcrIndex 7; MUST equal the quoted PCR 7 SHA-256 value; MUST include the SecureBoot/PK/KEK/db/dbx events

nonceBind.verifierChallenge: 32-byte CSPRNG value generated by the verifier at quote time. Retained as measuredBootBind.quote.verifierChallenge.
nonceBind.preimage: u16be(len(runIdentity utf-8)) || runIdentity utf-8 || u16be(len(observedAt decimal ASCII)) || observedAt decimal ASCII || u16be(len(subject canonical JSON utf-8)) || subject canonical JSON utf-8 || u16be(len(signedCarrierDigest 64-hex utf-8)) || signedCarrierDigest 64-hex utf-8 || u16be(32) || verifierChallenge. u16be is a 2-byte big-endian length. subject canonical JSON is extras-rejected {kind, name, version, digest} with those keys in that order.
nonceBind.nonce: SHA-256 of that preimage. This is the TPM2_Quote qualifyingData. Unframed concatenation is not this bind.

pathlessCeremony.akJoin: quote.signature MUST verify under quote.qualifiedSigner. qualifiedSigner MUST identify akCertificateMember. akCertificateMember MUST be a certificate-store DIGEST-BOUND signed TCB allowlist member. Unknown, unmatched, or extra certificate refuses.
pathlessCeremony.unavailableRefuses: no TPM 2.0, no TCG2 log, Secure Boot disabled, no unique pre-separator kernel event, quote failure, nonce mismatch, PCR 4 or PCR 7 replay mismatch, unknown AK, PE/COFF image-digest mismatch, or non-PE/COFF kernel member refuses this profile on this machine. Linux remains a D-002 slice-1 platform; the machine fails qualification.

platformAttestationOperation.unsupportedPairRefuses: macos/package-db, linux/codesign, alpine/arch/OTHER-PUBLISHER PLATFORM-ATTESTED, and any other pair refuse until a later successor adds them.
platformAttestationOperation.fileBackedBinding: macos-codesign: same SecCode guest. linux-file-backed: openedObjectObservation plus matchedManifestMember path+hash. No or-choice.
platformAttestationOperation.failClosed: Unknown interface, failed validity, untrusted chain, unavailable database, ambiguous subject or owning package, or identifier/trust mismatch refuses.

PLATFORM-ATTESTED.observedRecord: loaderTraces.observedPlatformAttestation is the only producer-visible observed PLATFORM-ATTESTED record. authenticityCore stays the signed-to-observed identity member.

DIGEST-BOUND.requires: named collision-resistant digest algorithm identifier plus a canonical collection membership/root rule over the observed bytes.

optionalLibcCompanion.comparison: sonameAbi is metadata only. Presence, absence, or mismatch NEVER changes allow/refuse and is not authenticity drift. Retained as companionObservation.

identityEvidenceUnion.comparison: The harness compares the observed resolved object to the tagged authenticity evidence. Selector exactness is EXACT-BUILD under identifierSchemes. CLOSED-RANGE is prohibited. Filesystem other-types use OTHER-FSTYPE. SONAME-ABI lives under companions, not tags. sonameAbi never decides identity and never changes allow/refuse.

encodingByTag.PLATFORM-ATTESTED: signed-only envelope sibling sonameAbi: { soname, abiSelector } beside authenticityCore. Never inside payload.
encodingByTag.DIGEST-BOUND: named optional field sonameAbi: { soname, abiSelector } inside the DIGEST-BOUND libc payload.

SONAME-ABI.comparison: metadata only. Presence, absence, or mismatch NEVER changes allow/refuse. Authenticity remains the attested or digest-bound object. When a signed sonameAbi companion is present at the encodingByTag location, the corresponding libc event MUST retain companionObservation. Not identity drift.

pathlessClasses.onlyIf: PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED may be used only for these classes. Other classes MUST NOT use that tag.
pathlessClasses.rule: These classes MUST use volumeConstraint PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED and MUST NOT use INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME or EXTERNAL-ORIGIN. A file-backed install-root volume predicate cannot represent them. A signed OS ABI entry with any other volumeConstraint tag refuses.

pathlessObservation.subject: the closed per-scheme subject variant in PLATFORM-ATTESTED.subjectByScheme; not untyped prose
pathlessObservation.binding: pathlessObservation.scheme/subject plus observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore MUST join per subjectByScheme.binding. Ambiguous, failed, unknown, or mismatched subjects refuse.

pathlessClasses.linuxStanding: OS ABI MUST use PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED. On Linux that tag uses measuredBootBind with PE/COFF image-digest equality. Machines without TPM/event-log/UEFI-Secure-Boot-firmware-LoadImage refuse qualification. Linux is not removed from platforms.slice1.

originSearchPolicy.canonicalOrigin: Owned only inside volumeConstraint.tags.EXTERNAL-ORIGIN.signedObject for EXTERNAL entries. The pre-existing originSearchPolicy.canonicalOrigin prose is the human meaning; the signed location is the tag object.
originSearchPolicy.allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder: Closed ordered list of lookup steps. Anything outside the list is alternate and refuses.

environmentInfluence.entries: Each named variable maps to exactly one of { standing: FIXED, expectedValue: <canonical string> } or { standing: FORBIDDEN }. Unnamed variables have standing FORBIDDEN.
environmentInfluence.pathAndLoaderDefault: PATH and loader-config substitution variables (LD_LIBRARY_PATH, DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH, LD_PRELOAD, DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES, and class-equivalent loader substitution variables) are FORBIDDEN unless the signed entry lists the variable with standing FIXED and a concrete expectedValue. Naming the variable without a fixed value does not make substitution lawful.
environmentInfluence.lookupBinding: Every allowed lookup step in allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder is bound to immutable platformProfile plus signed-entry evidence. A step whose inputs include a FORBIDDEN or unnamed variable refuses.

originSearchPolicy.classAppropriateLookup: Class-specific tool/data lookup rule, or null if the class has none.

volumeConstraint.form: closed tagged union. Required on every signed entry. This is the only signed location of canonicalOrigin and pathlessObservation. Extra fields rejected.

laterEventVariant.observedPlatformAttestation: required when this entry identityEvidence is PLATFORM-ATTESTED; forbidden when DIGEST-BOUND. Closed {authenticityCore, trustDecision}.
laterEventVariant.objectAuthenticityBindRecord: required when PLATFORM-ATTESTED; tag linux-file-backed or macos-codesign. Forbidden when DIGEST-BOUND.

INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME.join: runPreselectionRecord volume/type equality; Linux also selected-record identity

signedObject.pathlessObservation: required; the closed {scheme, subject} form whose subject is the per-scheme subjectByScheme variant

laterEventVariant.objectAuthenticityBindRecord: required. macOS: tag macos-codesign. Linux: tag linux-pathless (measuredBootBind). Linux pathless is not withdrawn.

PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED.join: per-scheme subjectByScheme binding from the trusted platform observation to pathlessObservation.subject and observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore. observedPlatformAttestation.trustDecision.result MUST be success. Unknown/ambiguous/failed/mismatched refuse. OS ABI entries MUST use this tag.

signedObject.canonicalOrigin: required; a full object path after the same symlink-resolving canonicalization as filesystemMeasurementTarget.canonicalization. NFC then UTF-8. Not a search-root identity.

laterEventVariant.observedPlatformAttestation: required when this entry identityEvidence is PLATFORM-ATTESTED; forbidden when DIGEST-BOUND. Closed {authenticityCore, trustDecision}.
laterEventVariant.objectAuthenticityBindRecord: required when PLATFORM-ATTESTED; tag linux-file-backed or macos-codesign. Forbidden when DIGEST-BOUND.

EXTERNAL-ORIGIN.join: resolverObservation.canonicalPath bytes equal observedOrigin.actualOrigin bytes equal signed canonicalOrigin bytes. lookupStepIndex equals event.route. resolvedObjectIdentity is bound by same-event association (runIdentity + observedAt), not by a path projection from object identity. Install-root volume equality is forbidden.

volumeConstraint.defaultForbidden: A signed entry with no volumeConstraint tag is a failed successor. Cross-tag fields rejected.

originSearchPolicy.pathlessObservation: Owned only inside volumeConstraint.tags.PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED.signedObject. Not a sibling field.
